publicly_readable: One article, reprinted on worldin.economist.com in 2015 for the 30th edition ("Where's the world's worst?", by The Economist Intelligence Unit), read from an Internet Archive snapshot.
not_readable: Everything else in the issue. No other text of this edition was found in public form.

entries.quote: A drought in 2000–the worst for at least 30 years–will lead to food shortages in 2001.
entries.subject: Afghanistan food shortages

entries.quote: In 2001, large numbers of people in Afghanistan will die through disease, starvation or war. Many more will leave.
entries.subject: Afghanistan deaths and emigration

notes: Edition number counted from The World in 1987 = 1. Publication month not confirmed; year only. The reprint is The Economist's own web copy of the original article. The article names Afghanistan the worst country to be a citizen of in 2001 (an EIU ranking).
